summary: ADR-0050 accepted 2026-07-29; formal LKG recovery only via publish_knowledge_catalog.py --restore-lkg; recovery lock/verifies LKG, generation identity, artifact hashes, source/policy/query inputs, and main; older LKG allowed only as main ancestor with all indexed/publication inputs byte-matching; restores source snapshot, v2 catalog, projections, v1 compatibility catalog; validates publication, replays Locator gate and canonical smoke; stale LKG cannot replace newer main; post-restore failure rolls back four layers/current pointer with byte verification; publication activation is one rollback domain, current pointer last; builders/evaluator/Locator/core/publication scripts must match pinned main; stale-lock recovery conditions: dead/reused owner or malformed lock after 60s; pruning is separate prune_knowledge_generations.py --prune, never publication/recovery; protect current, LKG, five newest valid successful main-added generations; invalid/uncommitted/unrecognized dirs reported, never deleted; retention policy read from current main; pruning persists intent/authorization and evidence; failure logs append-only under logs/knowledge-context outside pruning; extends ADR-0048, complements ADR-0044, supersedes neither; retention changes require policy and ADR update
